## Quotes

> "Oh, ain’t this awful, Miss Cuthbert? Mr. Harrison sent me over to see if yous had come out all right."
>
> — John Henry Carter — [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P39](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0039)

> "Yas’m. Not quite so well, ma’am. We was struck. The lightning knocked over the kitchen chimbly and come down the flue and knocked over Ginger’s cage and tore a hole in the floor and went into the sullar. Yas’m."
>
> — John Henry Carter — [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P41](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0041)

> "Yas’m. He was hurt pretty bad. He was killed."
>
> — John Henry Carter — [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043)

## Relationships

### [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harrison--john-henry-carter.md)

John Henry Carter serves under Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) and acts as his messenger. Beyond this professional duty, Mr. Harrison's household experiences sudden upheaval when his parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md) is killed during a devastating hail storm that hits [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), +3 more_
